Stuart O'Hara

Darren Ivey
Paul "Mead" Bidmead | past_members = David "Dai" Jones }} '''Acrimony''' was a [[Wales|Welsh]] [[heavy metal music|heavy metal]] band from [[Swansea]] who was active during the 1990s. Releasing their debut album in 1994, they are regarded as the pioneers of [[stoner metal]] in the United Kingdom, and an important influence upon the scene.{{cite web |url=http://www.bbc.co.uk/wales/music/sites/acrimony/ |title=BBC Wales – Acrimony |access-date=10 December 2007 |publisher=BBC Wales |quote=Acrimony were formed in Swansea in 1991 and were arch exponents of the stoner/metal/psych crossover... |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071214140921/http://www.bbc.co.uk/wales/music/sites/acrimony/ |archive-date=14 December 2007 |url-status=live }}{{cite web |url = http://www.leafhound.com/band/acrimony/bio.html |title = Leafhound Records – Acrimony biography |access-date = 10 December 2007 |author = Leafhound Records |publisher = Leafhound Records |quote = [Acrimony were] among the first exponents of the UK stoner scene… |archive-url = https://archive.today/20071215005357/http://www.leafhound.com/band/acrimony/bio.html |archive-date = 15 December 2007 |url-status=dead |df = dmy-all }} ==Career== Although the band never achieved mainstream success, during their career they received much critical acclaim – they were nominated for the ''[[Kerrang!]]'' Best Newcomer award and earned top review ratings.{{cite web |url=http://www.bbc.co.uk/wales/music/sites/acrimony/ |title=BBC Wales – Acrimony |access-date=10 December 2007 |publisher=BBC Wales |quote=Their second album Tumuli Shroomaroom was critically acclaimed, scooping the top mark five-Ks review in ''[[Kerrang!]]'' magazine. They were nominated for the Kerrang! Best Newcomer award in 1996. |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071214140921/http://www.bbc.co.uk/wales/music/sites/acrimony/ |archive-date=14 December 2007 |url-status=live }} Acrimony have maintained a cult following in the British metal scene, their records reportedly selling for vast sums as collectors' items.{{cite web |url = http://www.leafhound.com/band/acrimony/bio.html |title = Leafhound Records |access-date = 10 December 2007 |author = Leafhound Records |publisher = Leafhound Records |quote = ...originals have become collectors items, changing hands on Ebay for phenomenal sums. |archive-url = https://archive.today/20071215005357/http://www.leafhound.com/band/acrimony/bio.html |archive-date = 15 December 2007 |url-status=dead |df = dmy-all }} [[AllMusic]] described their musical style as a "powerful blend of [[Black Sabbath]]’s heavy metal riffery, [[Hawkwind]]'s space rock excursions, and [[Blue Cheer]]'s fuzzed-out psychedelic feedback."{{cite web |url = https://www.allmusic.com/artist/acrimony-mn0001250337/biography |title = Biography Acrimony |access-date = 11 January 2020 |publisher = AllMusic |quote = |url-status = |df = dmy-all }} In 2019, ''Kerrang!'' listed Acrimony as part of "20 bands who didn't get the respect they deserved".{{cite web |url = https://www.kerrang.com/features/20-bands-who-didnt-get-the-respect-they-deserved/ |title = 20 BANDS WHO DIDN'T GET THE RESPECT THEY DESERVED |access-date = 15 January 2020 |author = Kerrang! |publisher = Kerrang! |quote = |url-status = |df = dmy-all }} ==Post split== Since their split in 1999, Stu O'Hara went on to play guitar in [[Iron Monkey (band)|Iron Monkey]] before the outfit disbanded, then he went on to form the Dukes of Nothing with other ex-Iron Monkey members and members of [[Orange Goblin]]. Lee 'Roy' went on to form Swansea-based [[crust punk|crust]], [[power violence]] six-piece Black Eye Riot along with Stu and Dorian. Darren and Mead formed the 9ine, and Mead has his own [[trance music|trance]] project Yeti. Lee 'Roy' Davies now plays in the heavy metal band Lifer. In 2008 Stu, Mead, Darren and Dorian re-grouped and wrote tracks as Sigiriya, releasing an album called ''Return to Earth'' in 2011. A change of vocalist came in Matt "Pipes" Williams for 2013 release ''Darkness Died Today''. Lee 'Roy' formed Woven Man and released their debut album entitled ''Revelry (In Our Arms)'' in January 2019. In November 2019, Acrimony's three albums, ''[[Hymns to the Stone]]'', ''[[Tumuli Shroomaroom]]'' and ''Bong On - Live Long!'' were reissued in 3CD digipack and remastered edition by the Dutch music label Burning World Records.{{cite web |url=https://burningworldrecords.bandcamp.com/album/the-chronicles-of-wode |title=Acrimony - The Chronicles Of Wode |access-date=10 January 2019 |publisher=Burning World Records |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200111050545/https://burningworldrecords.bandcamp.com/album/the-chronicles-of-wode |archive-date=11 January 2020 }} ==Band members== *Dorian "Dexter" Walters – vocals *Stuart O'Hara – guitar *Matthew Lee "Roy" Davies – guitar *Paul "Mead" Bidmead – bass *Darren Ivey – drums Former members *David "Dai" Jones – Bass ==Discography== ===Albums=== {| class="wikitable" !Year !Title !Label !Notes |- |1994 |''[[Hymns to the Stone]]'' |Godhead Records |Debut album |- |1997 |''[[Tumuli Shroomaroom]]'' |[[Peaceville Records]] |Reissued in 2007 on Leaf Hound Records |- |2007 |''Bong On -
